raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The scheduler fills the multimodal positions of `input_ids` with per-item pad values (radix-cache keys above the vocabulary). `embed_mm_inputs` clamps that tensor **in place** to `vocab_size - 1` before the token-embedding lookup, and the tensor is `forward_batch.input_ids`.

Models can read `input_ids` again after the multimodal routine. `Qwen4ExpVLModel.forward` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) hands `forward_batch.input_ids` to its per-layer N-gram embedding (PLE). So every image/video token, and every N-gram that spans the end of an image, is hashed as token `vocab_size - 1`, an unrelated vocabulary entry.

The Hugging Face reference hashes the processor's token ids, which hold the placeholder token (`<|image_pad|>` / `<|video_pad|>`) at those positions. In transformers v5.19.0, `Qwen4ExpModel.forward` takes `ple_input_ids = input_ids` before `masked_scatter` replaces the image and video embeddings, and passes `ple_input_ids` to the language model ([modeling_qwen4_exp.py#L2318-L2324](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.19.0/src/transformers/models/qwen4_exp/modeling_qwen4_exp.py#L2318-L2324), [#L2344](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.19.0/src/transformers/models/qwen4_exp/modeling_qwen4_exp.py#L2344), [#L2372](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.19.0/src/transformers/models/qwen4_exp/modeling_qwen4_exp.py#L2372)). The parity check below confirms the mismatch on upstream main and its fix.

The adaptive-dispatch split path (`_embed_mm_inputs_with_split`) embeds a `torch.cat` copy per group, so there `input_ids` kept the raw pad values (above the vocabulary) instead.

## Modifications

- `embed_mm_inputs`: before the clamp, write each modality's placeholder token id (`MultimodalInputs.im_token_id` / `video_token_id` / `audio_token_id`, set by the processor from the HF config) over that modality's mask. Modalities without a placeholder id keep the clamp, as before. `pad_mm_tokens` and the new fill share one modality-to-placeholder-id helper.
- `_embed_mm_inputs_with_split`: copy the rewritten ids of each group back into `input_ids`.
- Unchanged: the token embeddings (multimodal positions are overwritten by the encoder output either way, and the clamp still bounds every id), the host-side token ids used as radix/prefix keys, and text-only batches.
- New CPU unit test `test/registered/unit/managers/test_mm_placeholder_token_ids.py` (`base-a-test-cpu`).

**Behaviour for other models.**
- Every model that uses `embed_mm_inputs` now sees the placeholder token id, not `vocab_size - 1`, at multimodal positions of `forward_batch.input_ids` after the routine. The token embeddings at those positions are replaced by the encoder output either way.
- Gemma3n builds its per-layer inputs from `input_ids` before calling the routine, so it is unaffected.
- Input-token logprobs take their token ids from `extend_input_logprob_token_ids` (the request's own token ids), not from these `input_ids`, so they are unchanged.
- The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MTP draft has no PLE and takes its multimodal-position inputs from `mm_input_embeds`.
- Not covered: when EVS prunes tokens, `get_embedding_and_mask` returns a new `input_ids` tensor. The fill applies to that copy, and `forward_batch.input_ids` keeps the pad values there, as today.

## Accuracy Tests

### Parity with the Hugging Face processor

`nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4`, `--chunked-prefill-size 4096 --disable-radix-cache`. A test-only hook around `Qwen4ExpVLModel.forward` records, for each prefill chunk, the `input_ids` the PLE receives. Each request runs alone. The same chat is then built with `AutoProcessor.from_pretrained` of the same checkpoint (transformers 5.19.0: chat template plus `Qwen3VLProcessor`, `enable_thinking=False`), and the two id lists are compared position by position. The image sides are multiples of 32, so neither processor resizes.

| Request | Prompt tokens | Image tokens | Prefill chunks | upstream main vs HF | this PR vs HF |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| short text | 21 | 0 | 1 | identical | identical |
| long text | 9,713 | 0 | 3 | identical | identical |
| 1 image, 448x448 | 217 | 196 | 1 | 196 ids differ | identical |
| 1 image, 640x320 | 220 | 200 | 1 | 200 ids differ | identical |
| 2 images, 512x256 + 256x512 | 278 | 256 | 1 | 256 ids differ | identical |
| 2 images, 1792x1792 (a chunk boundary falls inside the second image) | 6,295 | 6,272 | 2 | 6,272 ids differ | identical |

On upstream main, the differing positions are exactly the image positions: the PLE receives 248319 (`vocab_size - 1`) where HF has 248056 (`<|image_pad|>`). With this PR, every position matches. The result is the same on 1x GB300 (TP1, `--enable-deterministic-inference --attention-backend flashinfer`) and on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (TP2).

### MMMU

Upstream's `benchmark/mmmu/bench_sglang.py`, `MMMU/MMMU` validation at revision `876ce5cb130f`, against the server above:

```bash
python3 benchmark/mmmu/bench_sglang.py --port <port> --concurrency 32 --max-new-tokens 512 --temperature 0 \
  --dataset-path <MMMU/MMMU validation, revision 876ce5cb130f> \
  --extra-request-body '{"extra_body": {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": false}}}'
```

Main and this PR ran on the same GPU(s), with the same server arguments. The comparison uses the items both runs scored.

| Hardware | Items | upstream main | this PR | Items whose answer changed | Only main correct / only PR correct |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1x GB300, TP1, deterministic | 870 | 61.1 % (532) | 60.8 % (529) | 300 | 94 / 91 |
| 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, TP2, not deterministic; 3 main runs, 2 PR runs | 780 | 61.0 / 63.6 / 64.4 % | 62.1 / 62.6 % | 252-270 (main vs main: 158-170) | — |

The fix changes about a third of the answers, but accuracy does not move beyond run-to-run noise. On GB300 (deterministic), the paired difference is 3 of 870 items (McNemar p = 0.88). On RTX PRO 6000, which has no deterministic mode, both PR runs fall inside the range of three main runs.

### Unit test (CPU)

6 tests (7 cases). On upstream main, 4 tests fail (5 cases): the placeholder positions hold `vocab_size - 1`, or raw pad values on the split path. With this PR, all 6 pass.

| Test | upstream main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| pad values are out of vocab (fixture check) | pass | pass |
| placeholder id written in place, 1 and 2 requests | fail, fail | pass, pass |
| image and video get their own placeholder id | fail | pass |
| chunked prefill boundary inside an image | fail | pass |
| no placeholder id configured: falls back to the clamp | pass | pass |
| adaptive-dispatch split path (mixed precomputed batch) | fail | pass |

Every case also asserts that the embeddings are bitwise equal to the expected embeddings and that the host-side key ids keep their pad values. The existing `test_mm_utils_split.py` passes 16/16.

### Text outputs are unchanged

`nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4`, TP1 on 1x GB300, `--enable-deterministic-inference --attention-backend flashinfer`, NEXTN MTP (3 steps, 4 draft tokens), greedy, main and this PR on the same GPU:

| Requests | Main vs this PR |
|---|---|
| 4 text prompts (incl. a multi-chunk ~6K-word prompt) | identical |
| 4 image chats (3 single-image, 1 two-image) | all 4 changed: the model now sees the placeholder id at image positions |

Both arms are repeat-identical.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No speed claim. The change adds one `masked_fill_` per modality on the multimodal prefill path, and nothing on text-only batches.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed: no new flag, env var or user-visible behavior beyond the fix.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Accuracy: HF parity and MMMU above. Speed: no claim (one `masked_fill_` per modality).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Prepared with the help of Claude Code; every result above was measured as described.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+
+The scheduler fills the multimodal positions of input_ids with per-item pad values

+forward_batch.input_ids, and models can read it again after the embedding: Qwen4-Exp's
+per-layer N-gram embedding hashes token N-grams of it. Each modality's placeholder
+token id (im_token_id / video_token_id) must replace its pad values there, as in the
+HF reference, on both the plain and the adaptive-dispatch split path. Embeddings and
+the host-side key ids keep their values.
+
+CPU-only: no engine, GPU or weights.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace

+import torch
+from torch import nn

+from sglang.srt.managers import mm_schedule, mm_utils
+from sglang.srt.managers.req_types import (
+    MM_PAD_SHIFT_VALUE,
+    MultimodalDataItem,
+    MultimodalInputs,
+)
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.modality import Modality
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_parallel
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+VOCAB = 64
+HIDDEN = 8
+IMAGE_TOKEN_ID = 41
+VIDEO_TOKEN_ID = 42
+# Two items per request; (start, end) offsets are inclusive, as processors emit them.
+OFFSETS = [(3, 6), (10, 12)]
+SEQ_LEN = 16
+
+
+def _feature(item: MultimodalDataItem) -> torch.Tensor:
+    start, end = item.offsets[0]
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(item.hash)
+    return torch.randn(end - start + 1, HIDDEN, generator=gen)
+
+
+class _FakeVLM:
+    def get_image_feature(self, items):
+        return torch.cat([_feature(item) for item in items], dim=0)
+
+    def get_video_feature(self, items):
+        return torch.cat([_feature(item) for item in items], dim=0)
+
+
+def _request(
+    req_seed,
+    im_token_id,
+    modalities=(Modality.IMAGE, Modality.IMAGE),
+    video_token_id=None,
+    precomputed=False,
+):
+    """One request: text ids < VOCAB, item runs filled with their items' pad values.
+
+    Returns (mm_inputs, host key ids, multimodal positions per modality).
+    """
+    items = []
+    for i, (offset, modality) in enumerate(zip(OFFSETS, modalities)):
+        item = MultimodalDataItem(
+            modality=modality, feature=torch.zeros(1), offsets=[offset]
+        )
+        item.set_hash(1_000 * req_seed + 7 * i + 1)
+        if precomputed:
+            item.precomputed_embeddings = _feature(item)
+        items.append(item)
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(req_seed)
+    ids = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (SEQ_LEN,), generator=gen)
+    positions = {m: torch.zeros(SEQ_LEN, dtype=torch.bool) for m in Modality.all()}
+    for item in items:
+        start, end = item.offsets[0]
+        ids[start : end + 1] = torch.tensor(item.padding_sequence(end - start + 1))
+        positions[item.modality][start : end + 1] = True
+    mm_inputs = MultimodalInputs(
+        mm_items=items, im_token_id=im_token_id, video_token_id=video_token_id
+    )
+    return mm_inputs, ids, positions
+
+
+def _embedding():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    return nn.Embedding(VOCAB, HIDDEN)
+
+
+def _embed(mm_inputs_list, input_ids, prefix_lens, seq_lens):
+    embedding = _embedding()
+    embeds, _ = mm_utils.embed_mm_inputs(
+        mm_inputs_list=mm_inputs_list,
+        extend_prefix_lens=prefix_lens,
+        extend_seq_lens=seq_lens,
+        input_ids=input_ids,
+        input_embedding=embedding,
+        multimodal_model=_FakeVLM(),
+    )
+    return embeds, embedding
+
+
+def _expected_embeds(mm_inputs_list, host_ids, embedding):
+    """Token embeddings, with each item's feature over its run."""
+    expected = embedding(host_ids.clamp(0, VOCAB - 1)).clone()
+    for r, mm in enumerate(mm_inputs_list):
+        for item in mm.mm_items:
+            start, end = item.offsets[0]
+            expected[r * SEQ_LEN + start : r * SEQ_LEN + end + 1] = _feature(item)
+    return expected
+
+
+def _case_pad_values_are_out_of_vocab():
+    _, ids, positions = _request(1, IMAGE_TOKEN_ID)
+    assert bool((ids[positions[Modality.IMAGE]] >= MM_PAD_SHIFT_VALUE).all())
+
+
+def _case_placeholder_token_id_written_in_place(num_requests):
+    reqs = [_request(seed, IMAGE_TOKEN_ID) for seed in range(1, num_requests + 1)]
+    mm_inputs_list = [mm for mm, _, _ in reqs]
+    host_ids = torch.cat([ids for _, ids, _ in reqs])
+    image_positions = torch.cat([pos[Modality.IMAGE] for _, _, pos in reqs])
+    input_ids = host_ids.clone()  # forward_batch.input_ids, copied from the host ids
+
+    embeds, embedding = _embed(
+        mm_inputs_list, input_ids, [0] * num_requests, [SEQ_LEN] * num_requests
+    )
+
+    assert bool((input_ids[image_positions] == IMAGE_TOKEN_ID).all())
+    assert torch.equal(input_ids[~image_positions], host_ids[~image_positions])
+    # The host key ids (radix / prefix keys) keep their pad values.
+    assert bool((host_ids[image_positions] >= MM_PAD_SHIFT_VALUE).all())
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        embeds, _expected_embeds(mm_inputs_list, host_ids, embedding), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+
+
+def _case_image_and_video_get_their_own_placeholder():
+    mm, host_ids, positions = _request(
+        5,
+        IMAGE_TOKEN_ID,
+        modalities=(Modality.IMAGE, Modality.VIDEO),
+        video_token_id=VIDEO_TOKEN_ID,
+    )
+    input_ids = host_ids.clone()
+
+    embeds, embedding = _embed([mm], input_ids, [0], [SEQ_LEN])
+
+    assert bool((input_ids[positions[Modality.IMAGE]] == IMAGE_TOKEN_ID).all())
+    assert bool((input_ids[positions[Modality.VIDEO]] == VIDEO_TOKEN_ID).all())
+    mm_positions = positions[Modality.IMAGE] | positions[Modality.VIDEO]
+    assert torch.equal(input_ids[~mm_positions], host_ids[~mm_positions])
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        embeds, _expected_embeds([mm], host_ids, embedding), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+
+
+def _case_chunk_boundary_inside_an_image():
+    # Second chunk of a chunked prefill: it starts inside the first image.
+    mm, ids, positions = _request(3, IMAGE_TOKEN_ID)
+    prefix = 5
+    chunk = ids[prefix:].clone()
+    chunk_positions = positions[Modality.IMAGE][prefix:]
+
+    embeds, _ = _embed([mm], chunk, [prefix], [SEQ_LEN - prefix])
+
+    assert bool((chunk[chunk_positions] == IMAGE_TOKEN_ID).all())
+    assert torch.equal(chunk[~chunk_positions], ids[prefix:][~chunk_positions])
+    full = _FakeVLM().get_image_feature(mm.mm_items)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        embeds[chunk_positions], full[prefix - OFFSETS[0][0] :], rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+
+
+def _case_without_placeholder_token_id_falls_back_to_clamp():
+    mm, ids, positions = _request(4, None)
+    image_positions = positions[Modality.IMAGE]
+    input_ids = ids.clone()
+
+    embeds, _ = _embed([mm], input_ids, [0], [SEQ_LEN])
+
+    assert bool((input_ids[image_positions] == VOCAB - 1).all())
+    assert torch.equal(input_ids[~image_positions], ids[~image_positions])
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        embeds[image_positions],
+        _FakeVLM().get_image_feature(mm.mm_items),
+        rtol=0,
+        atol=0,
+    )
+
+
+def _case_split_path_mixed_precomputed():
+    # Adaptive encoder dispatch embeds a torch.cat copy per group; input_ids must
+    # still end up with the placeholder ids.
+    reqs = [
+        _request(6, IMAGE_TOKEN_ID, precomputed=True),
+        _request(7, IMAGE_TOKEN_ID, precomputed=False),
+    ]
+    mm_inputs_list = [mm for mm, _, _ in reqs]
+    host_ids = torch.cat([ids for _, ids, _ in reqs])
+    image_positions = torch.cat([pos[Modality.IMAGE] for _, _, pos in reqs])
+    input_ids = host_ids.clone()
+    forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+        extend_seq_lens_cpu=[SEQ_LEN, SEQ_LEN], mm_inputs=mm_inputs_list
+    )
+    embedding = _embedding()
+
+    embeds, _ = mm_utils._embed_mm_inputs_with_split(
+        mm_inputs_list=mm_inputs_list,
+        extend_prefix_lens=[0, 0],
+        extend_seq_lens=[SEQ_LEN, SEQ_LEN],
+        input_ids=input_ids,
+        forward_batch=forward_batch,
+        input_embedding=embedding,
+        multimodal_model=_FakeVLM(),
+    )
+
+    assert bool((input_ids[image_positions] == IMAGE_TOKEN_ID).all())
+    assert torch.equal(input_ids[~image_positions], host_ids[~image_positions])
+    assert bool((host_ids[image_positions] >= MM_PAD_SHIFT_VALUE).all())
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        embeds, _expected_embeds(mm_inputs_list, host_ids, embedding), rtol=0, atol=0
+    )
+
+
+class TestMMPlaceholderTokenIds(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        # The embedding path reads the config namespaces and the attention-TP rank.
+        self._server_args = get_context().override_server_args(tp_size=1)
+        self._server_args.install()
+        self._parallel = get_parallel().override(
+            attn_tp_rank=0, attn_tp_size=1, tp_size=1
+        )
+        self._parallel.__enter__()
+        mm_schedule.init_mm_embedding_cache(1 << 30)
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self._parallel.__exit__(None, None, None)
+        self._server_args.restore()
+
+    def test_pad_values_are_out_of_vocab(self):
+        _case_pad_values_are_out_of_vocab()
+
+    def test_placeholder_token_id_written_in_place(self):
+        for num_requests in (1, 2):
+            with self.subTest(num_requests=num_requests):
+                _case_placeholder_token_id_written_in_place(num_requests)
+
+    def test_image_and_video_get_their_own_placeholder(self):
+        _case_image_and_video_get_their_own_placeholder()
+
+    def test_chunk_boundary_inside_an_image(self):
+        _case_chunk_boundary_inside_an_image()
+
+    def test_without_placeholder_token_id_falls_back_to_clamp(self):
+        _case_without_placeholder_token_id_falls_back_to_clamp()
+
+    def test_split_path_mixed_precomputed(self):
+        _case_split_path_mixed_precomputed()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
